title: Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program Fee Schedule: Usage Fees, Fee Periods and What the Fee Covers
content:
The usage fee is the charge a household pays for the use of a district-owned instrument under the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program for one fee period. The schedule below states, for each usage type, the usage fee in US dollars, the period the fee covers, the mid-year terms and the settlement period.

## Usage fee and fee period

| Usage type | Usage fee for the fee period (USD) | Period the usage fee covers | Mid-year start date | Share of the usage fee charged for a checkout starting on or after the mid-year start date | Calendar days after the usage fee posts within which it must be settled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | 50.00 | school year | January 4 | 50% | 30 |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | 100.00 | school year | January 4 | 50% | 30 |
| Brass Instrument Usage | 100.00 | school year | January 4 | 50% | 30 |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | 100.00 | school year | January 4 | 50% | 30 |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | 125.00 | school year | January 4 | 50% | 30 |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | 40.00 | summer | January 4 | 100% | 30 |

The mid-year start date is the date on or after which a school-year checkout is charged the mid-year rate. The schedule lists a mid-year share for Summer Instrument Checkout as well; that usage type's fee period is the summer, not the school year.

## What the usage fee covers

| Usage type | Routine maintenance and normal wear repairs covered by the usage fee | End-of-year chemical cleaning covered by the usage fee | Usage fee insures the instrument against loss or theft |
|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | yes | yes | no |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | yes | yes | no |
| Brass Instrument Usage | yes | yes | no |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | yes | yes | no |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | yes | yes | no |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | yes | yes | no |

## Schedule notes

- **Shared figures.** Woodwind Instrument Usage, Brass Instrument Usage and Orchestra String Instrument Usage share the same usage fee of 100.00; Percussion Equipment Usage is 50.00 and Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) is 125.00. Summer Instrument Checkout is 40.00 for the summer.
- **Mid-year rate in figures.** Under each school-year usage type the mid-year share is 50% of the usage fee: 25.00 for Percussion Equipment Usage; 50.00 for Woodwind, Brass and Orchestra String Instrument Usage; 62.50 for Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass).
- **Settlement period.** Under every usage type the usage fee is to be settled within 30 calendar days after it posts.
- **Insurance.** Under no usage type does the usage fee insure the instrument against loss or theft.
